title: Travel Protection Plans: Baggage, Delay and Missed Connection Schedule
content:
The baggage, delay and missed connection benefits of a Travel Protection Plans certificate each carry a limit per insured traveller, and the delay benefits additionally carry the number of hours from which they become payable. The limits are in USD and the triggers in whole hours.

## Table A — Baggage

| Plan | Lost or damaged baggage, per traveller | Ceiling on any single article | Baggage delay, per traveller | Baggage delay payable from, hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 750.00 | 250.00 | 200.00 | 24 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 1000.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 | 12 |
| TripGuard Plus | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 12 |
| TripGuard Premier | 2500.00 | 750.00 | 750.00 | 6 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 2500.00 | 750.00 | 750.00 | 6 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 12 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 3500.00 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 6 |

## Table B — Travel delay

| Plan | Travel delay, per traveller | Payable from, hours | Daily ceiling within the benefit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 300.00 | 12 | 150.00 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 500.00 | 8 | 200.00 |
| TripGuard Plus | 1000.00 | 6 | 250.00 |
| TripGuard Premier | 1500.00 | 5 | 300.00 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 1500.00 | 5 | 300.00 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 1000.00 | 6 | 250.00 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 2000.00 | 3 | 400.00 |

## Table C — Missed connection

| Plan | Missed connection, per traveller | Payable from, hours |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 0.00 | 0 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 500.00 | 6 |
| TripGuard Plus | 1000.00 | 3 |
| TripGuard Premier | 1500.00 | 3 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 1500.00 | 3 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 1000.00 | 3 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 2500.00 | 3 |

Footnote: a limit of 0.00 beside a trigger of 0, as on Trip Basics Essential in Table C, marks a benefit the plan does not carry. The inner ceilings in Table A and Table B — the ceiling on any single article and the daily ceiling — sit inside the benefit limit on the same row and do not add to it.
